coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (scalar coupling to electron mass)
notes: Paper presents projected PTA constraints on ultralight dark matter (ULDM) couplings to fundamental constants via pulsar timing arrays. The analysis focuses on scalar ULDM field φ with mass 10^-23 to 10^-20 eV coupling to SM particles. Multiple coupling types are constrained: d_ê_m (quark mass), d_e (electron mass), d_µ (muon mass), d_γ (photon/EM coupling), and d_g (gluon/QCD coupling). Data points extracted from Figure 1 (d_e panel) showing IPTA correlated constraints. The paper uses mock data mimicking IPTA DR2 dataset and projects future PTA sensitivities. Local DM density ρ_φ = 0.4 GeV/cm³ is assumed throughout. Confidence level is 95% (stated in text). Extraction confidence is moderate (0.65) because: (1) multiple coupling types are analyzed but only d_e is extracted here; (2) data points are read from plots rather than tables; (3) the paper emphasizes these are projections on mock data, not actual measured limits. The paper compares favorably to atomic clock and torsion balance constraints but does not present a single dominant coupling type—it's a multi-parameter study. | selector: text (sole candidate)
